label_derivation_rule: dominant_class(): majority by box instance COUNT, ties broken by total box AREA, then alphabetically — see training/detection/ground_pv/condition_taxonomy.py

minority_annotation_disclosure: 910 of 2411 images had more than one distinct active class present in their box annotations; only the dominant class was kept as this image's single classifier label, per the reformulation's single-label design. This is a real information loss versus the detection dataset, disclosed here not hidden.
